integrity: The analysis independently reconstructs the finite three-person probability law, proves a strictly monotone shape inverse, and separates exact structural identification from practical conditioning. A standalone standard-library checker tests finite examples; no external validation or universal numerical certificate is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact population probabilities and a finite-shape, unit-mean Gamma infectious period are assumed. The model covers single introductions into two- and three-person households with homogeneous mixing; finite-sample precision, unknown duration scale, and larger household collections are not identified by this theorem.
title: Exact three-parameter identification from two- and three-person household epidemics
